briefdescription.para: Sparse / varpower-format ResMonoid implementation: monomials laid out as length-prefixed lists of (variable, exponent) pairs.

detaileddescription.para: Each encoded monomial has variable width: [length, hash, Computations, w_1, ..., w_r, v_1, e_1, ..., v_d, e_d]. Encode / decode walk only the non-zero variables, so the representation wins when monomials are typically supported in a small subset of variables; the dense counterpart is ResMonoidDense.
